remarks: Welcome to this beautifully renovated second floor apartment in the highly sought after Springdale neighborhood of Stamford. This move in ready rental offers two spacious bedrooms, an updated kitchen with new appliances and bath, bright living spaces, and a functional floor plan designed for comfortable everyday living.  Situated in a well maintained two family home on a corner lot, the property offers excellent curb appeal and ample off street parking. Enjoy an unbeatable commuter friendly location just one mile from the Springdale MetroNorth station and a short walk to the bus line, with easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, and major highways.  A rare opportunity to lease a renovated apartment in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods. Schedule your private showing today!
